No. 2107/34 – WEDNESDAY, JANUARY, 23, 2019
EXTRAORDINARY
THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
AS AMENDED BY THE LAND ACQUISITION
(AMENDMENT) ACT NO. 28 OF 1964
(Notice Under Section 7)
My Ref No.: ARA/LND/ACQV1/D3/43. Ministry of land, and Parliamentary reforms Ref. No.:

4-3/15/2016/VE/442. I, hereby give notice, under Sub-section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, that the Government intends to acquire the following land/servitude which is required for a public purpose :- Description of the land or servitude to be acquired : An allotment of land is called Panapura watta about 2.0738 hectares in extent and depicted as Lot 01,02,03,04 and 05 in P.P.K. Plan Number 3595 and dated 05.07.2018 made by the Survey General and situated in the village of Thalgaspitiya Marakalagama, in the Grama Niladhari Division of No. 44C, Thalgaspitiya Marakkalagama, in the Minor Division of Mahapalatha Pathuwa, in the Divisional Secretariat Division of Aranayaka, in the District of Kegalle, in Sabaragamuwa Province. Boundaries are as follows .
01. Lot No. 1 Name of the Land: Panapurawatta; Extent : 0.7182 Hectare.
Boundaries North : Panapura Ma Kumbura and Panapurawatta; East : Panapura watta and Road (Road Development
Authority); South: Road (Road Development Authority), Lot No. 2 and Panapurawatta; West: Panapura watta and Panapura Ma Kumbura.

Other particulars : Lot No. 24 (T.P. 246218) is a part of preliminary plan No. 8108 and the Land has been acquired under Section 38 (A) of the Land Acquisition Act. Mr. Mothilal Neru and Mr. M. Weerapandian who are preliminary claimants and resident of Thalgaspitiya Muslimgama, for the completion of acquisition activities.

02. Lot No. 2 Name of the Land: -; Extent : 0.1897 Hectare. Boundaries North : Panapurawatta and Lot No. 1; East : Road (Road Development Authority) and Panapurawatta; South: Panapurawatta and Lots No. 3 and 4; West: Lot No. 5 and Panapurawatta.

Other particulars : Lot No. 24 (T.P. 246218) of preliminary plan No. 8108 and Lot No. 4418 (T.P.259100) of preliminary plan No. 1583 and the Land has been acquired under Section 38 (A) of the Land Acquisition Act. Mr. Mothilal Neru and Mr. M. Weerapandian who are preliminary claimants and resident of Thalgaspitiya Muslimgama, for the completion of acquisition activities.
03. Lot No. 3 Name of the Land: Panapurawatta; Extent : 0.2317 Hectare.

All persons interested in the aforesaid land/lands on which a servitude is to be acquired are hereby required to appear personally, or by agents duly authorized in writing, before me at Divisional Secretariat Aranayaka on the 15 day of February 2019 10.00 a.m. and are hereby requested to notify to me in writing (in duplicate) on or before the 08 day of February 2019 the nature of their interests in the land, the particulars of their claims for compensation for the acquisition of the said land/servitude, the amount of compensation and the details of the computation of such amount.
Z.A.M. FAISAL, Divisional Secretary, Aranayaka. Divisional Secretariat, Aranayaka. 18th January, 2019.
